note: Dowley family campground in the West River valley near Newfane, with wooded and open sites; the river is a walk away across VT 30, and the campground sits back from it. Mostly seasonal: in spring imagery most sites hold parked trailers with decks or sheds, so nightly sites are the minority. Tent sites and the one lean-to take stays of up to 14 days. --Claude

Price gate passes (under $50). Google 4.7 (103). LONG-STAY: imagery a week into the 2024 season shows ~100 trailers with decks/sheds across a 150+ site park - mostly seasonal; not iffy (4.7/103, live booking) -> keep with a mostly-seasonal note. Not waterfront confirmed (West River ~450 m, across VT 30 and fields). Pin inside the park.
